free_tier.stated: 40 GB free drive space. Own site: '免费提供网络硬盘空间 40GB'. Per-file: 5 GB ('单个文件最大可达5GB'). No login needed to send; login needed to keep.

egress.terms: Unmetered and unshaped — the entire product pitch is '永不限速', confirmed by the homepage title and by PanHunt's '永不限速' row.

tooling: qaiu/netdisk-fast-download `ws` parser (302 direct link); dtpoi/Netdisk-to-VRChat-Direct-link resolves 文叔叔 links via Edge Functions. No mount, no WebDAV — download-only.
chaining: 40 GB per account x N phone/email accounts. The interesting object is the 5 GB/file ceiling with zero speed shaping — usable as a *serving* layer, not as bulk cold storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 5 GB. storage: 40 GB total. retention: transfer links expire; drive files persist only while the account is alive. No published request-rate.

identity_cost.detail: any-phone (phone binding raises the free space toward the 40 GB ceiling; anonymous sending works but does not give you storage).

reliability_note: Single-product company; historically pivoted pricing. Nothing suggests data loss within an active account.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
